title: The Salt Summit
author: Ansel Fairweather
blurb: Rosalind Oyelaran, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
